cohort: 1638 newborns admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Assiut Children's Hospital in Upper Egypt between January 1st and December 31st, 2020, including 930 (56.8%) preterm and 708 (43.2%) full-term infants.
finding: The neonatal mortality rate was high (43.2%), with respiratory distress syndrome being the leading cause of death among preterm inborn infants and multiple congenital anomalies being the leading cause of death among both inborn and outborn full-term infants.
followup_time: The length of hospital stay, which varied depending on the infant's condition and outcome.
birth_weight: Recorded, but specific ranges not mentioned in abstract
